text: Reporting an accident from this morning, 8:40 or so, at the crossroads by the canal in Dublin. It was pouring and the lights were flashing amber because of a fault. I was crossing in my blue Toyota Corolla (2019) and a delivery van came in from the right at the same moment. I will admit I did not slow down enough for the conditions, but he also never gave way and was going far too quick. Both of us clipped each other mid-junction. My passenger door is dented in and the wing mirror is gone. Nobody hurt. The guard who attended said it was probably a split between us.

hi, accident near Cape Town 23:30 last nite, clear sky, I was stopped in traffic and a bakkie came flying into the back of my Volkswagen, no brakes at all. boot is crushed into the back seats and the car was towed. neck is sore, ambulance took me to Groote Schuur. driver admitted he fell asleep. pls call asap

Namaste. Around 2:20 in the afternoon I was driving slowly through the crowded market lane near Dadar station in Mumbai. The rain had stopped but the road was still wet and slick. My silver Maruti slid a little when I braked and the front corner nudged a fruit stall and brushed a man's arm. He was shouting but not really hurt. मेरी गलती थी, मुझे पहले धीरे चलाना चाहिए था. The stall owner wants money for the spoiled fruit. Please tell me what is covered.

Urgente: accidente grave en Madrid a las 19:15. Estaba girando a la izquierda en la rotonda con mi SEAT blanco y otro coche venia de frente tambien girando, ninguno cedio el paso. Chocamos de frente. Los airbags saltaron, el motor esta destrozado y la grua se lo llevo. Me duele el pecho y mi hijo tiene un corte en la frente. Ambos pensamos que el otro debia ceder, la policia dice que la culpa se reparte. Necesito un coche de sustitucion. (My SEAT is white, in case the form needs English.)

Schadenmeldung. On the A23 near Vienna at approximately 07:50 under overcast skies, I was travelling in the middle lane in my grey Skoda Octavia (2021) at a steady 80 km/h. A white estate car changed lanes from the right without indicating and scraped along my front-right wing. The other driver stated, ich habe Sie nicht gesehen, and accepted responsibility on the spot. Damage: paint abrasion and a cracked indicator housing. No injuries. Both vehicles were driven away.

G'day, came back to my 2016 Mazda around 1pm at the Westfield car park in Sydney and found a long scrape down the driver's side plus a bit of white paint transfer. No note, nobody around, and the cameras apparently only cover the exits. Could have been anyone or even me clipping a pillar earlier, honestly can't say. Not urgent, just want it on record in case a witness turns up.

Please help, I do not know who else to call. This morning at about 6:30 on the Bosphorus bridge approach in Istanbul the fog was so thick that the lane markings vanished. I was driving my silver Hyundai i20 (2018) at a careful speed behind a line of traffic. A minibus coming up behind me never reduced speed, I saw its lights in the mirror for one second and then it hit me hard and pushed my car into the sedan ahead of me, and then a second truck hit the minibus and the whole line piled up, maybe eight or nine vehicles. My bonnet is folded, the windscreen is shattered and the rear end is flattened like paper. I was pulled out through the passenger door. The ambulance took me to the hospital with a broken collarbone and cuts on my face. The police report states that the minibus driver was driving too fast for the visibility, so I believe the blame is his. Çok korktum, lütfen beni arayın. My brother is dealing with the tow company, please send the forms to him as well. Thank you.

I made a stupid mistake. 1:10 am, coming off the expressway, the surface was still wet from the earlier shower and I was tired and looking at my phone. I ran into the back of a parked taxi with my black 2014 Chevrolet. My hood crumpled, radiator hissing. The taxi's bumper is cracked and the driver came out yelling. It is on me, no question. How much will my premium go up?

Writing about the 16:40 incident outside the supermarket in Oslo. Grey sky, nothing special. I was waiting with my red Volvo at the end of the aisle, engine running, when a big estate car reversed out of its space without looking and rammed straight into my front wing and headlight. I honked the whole time. The young man blamed his rear camera. Wing is crumpled, headlight smashed, the bonnet will not close properly. He gave me his details but I do not trust him. Uffda, what a day.

Pole sana for the long message. On Thika Road in Nairobi at about 6:45 pm, the sun was still out and visibility was fine, when a matatu and my 2012 Toyota entered the junction together after the traffic signal went dark. We hit side-on, and my car spun around and ended on the pavement. Door crushed, airbag out, I was bleeding from the head. Each of us says the other jumped the queue and the traffic officers could not decide. There is a camera on the corner, maybe it recorded something.

I would like to open a claim for an incident that happened late on Friday evening, around 22:30, outside the beach promenade in Dubai. The night was warm and completely clear and the area was full of families walking between the cafes. My white Nissan Patrol (2022) was parked at the kerb of the pedestrian zone with the hazard lights on while I picked up my wife. A scooter rider, who was looking at a phone and weaving through the crowd, struck the driver's side mirror, bounced off the front door and fell against the car. He was shaken and scratched but walked away. The mirror housing is broken and there is a deep dent and paint damage on the door panel. Several witnesses and a security guard saw that he was riding on the walkway where it is not allowed, and the guard wrote down his name. The police report says he is responsible. الحمد لله لم يصب أحد بأذى. I can send photos of the damage and the footage that the cafe owner has offered to share. Please advise on the next steps and on whether a replacement car is available while the door is repaired.

Buenos dias, me paso esta manana a las 5:45 en el Periferico, Mexico City, con una niebla muy espesa. Iba en mi Ford gris y cambie de carril sin ver bien, pegue con el costado de un camion de reparto. Fue mi culpa, no lo vi en el espejo. Mi puerta trasera y el guardabarros estan doblados, el camion solo tiene una raya. Nadie salio herido, pero la grua tardo mas de una hora. Dime que papeles necesito mandar. (Ford, color grey.)
